provenanceNotes: Catalog assembled from bundled attribution metadata; external pages were not newly rechecked for this documentation task.
Wiktionary lemma, reconstruction and appendix pages are secondary/community-edited lexical resources; their underlying references and revision histories remain important.

Syrian Arabic telj and Mesopotamian Arabic thelij are selected regional readings supplied by the map author. The shared Arabic source link supports the lexical and etymological context; it is not independent validation of those exact regional romanizations.

Percent-encoding variants of the same path are merged into a single canonical lexical source. Distinct language fragments are retained as distinct source links. All literal variants are retained in urlAliases.
No single license is asserted over all third-party material. Geometry, dictionary content, font software and D3 retain their own stated licensing or terms.

The source atlas Kurdish area kurd1259 combines varieties across Turkey, Syria, Iraq and Iran. It uses Northern Kurdish berf as a selected reference; Central Kurdish befr is separately labelled, with both in the Iranian snow-word set.
The Kurdish supplements are historical/traditional language areas with reference year 1750, not contemporary prevalence estimates or newly inferred ethnic boundaries.
